    Sizes from the model

    Russell compared in doc/russell-octave-report.md. Computed by examples/light_hydrogen in kronspice (hypothesis H32). The cloud is 6,000 points drawn from |ψ1s|²; the 32 loops are the circuit whose mutual-inductance energy with the proton ring gives Fermi's contact energy. The electron's double loop is the (2, 1) path of Williamson & van der Mark. The particles' view spans 0.006 Bohr radii, a single point in the atom's view.
